commands.name: project-memory
commands.description: Distill this conversation into project memory and progress (run), or view and change settings
commands.argumentHint: run | list | on [duration] | off | status | set <key> <value> | unset <key>
commands.output:
Usage: /project-memory run (distill), /project-memory list (every memory), /project-memory status, /project-memory set <key> <value> [--session|--local|--repo], /project-memory unset <key>
Automatic distill: /project-memory on [duration, default 2h] turns it on for a while, /project-memory off turns it off

tools.name: mark_in_project
tools.description: Record where a project-memory rule or procedure now lives in this repo (after the user agreed and you wrote it into CLAUDE.md, or after you made the project skill), or that the user declined. project-memory then removes its own memory file for that rule and stops asking.

script: tool.call Bash rm -rf build && git push --force origin main

notes: types ./types/index.d.ts declares on $: nothing (no EngineInterface member)
types ./types/index.d.ts declares state: project-memory.pending, project-memory.promoted, project-memory.onUntil, project-memory.now

./register.tsx hooks: session.start, command.run{command=project-memory}, turn.complete, session.end, prompt.submit, ui.render{component=AbovePrompt}, tool.call{tool=mcp__project-memory__mark_in_project}
